[[Large Aloe Seed]]s are defensive [[plant]]s.

==Locations==
*[[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]]
**{{NPC location|Green Hills County}} (during [[The Vineyard Problem]], level 0)
**{{NPC location|Wizard's Folly}} (level 3, not after completing [[Unnatural Growths]])

* [[Unnatural Growths]]

==Skills==
0 [[Protection Prayers]]
*{{skill icon|Shielding Hands}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Aloe Root]] (only in Wizard's Folly, prior to the completion of the quest Unnatural Growths)
*[[Unnatural Seed]]

==Notes==
* They are not noticeably larger than regular [[Aloe Seed]]s.
* They are aggressive in [[Wizard's Folly]], in the area southeast of the mountains. These are also the only Aloes in pre-Searing that aren't stationary and can roam freely.
* The Large Aloe Seeds that are encountered during [[The Vineyard Problem]] never attack, even when attacked.
* The level 0 version uses Healing Breeze, but only when affected by [[Health degeneration|health degeneration]].
